text: 德国财政部长Lars Klingbeil计划在与二十国集团（G20）同僚于美国举行的会谈期间，呼吁结束对经济造成损害的冲突，包括关税争端以及伊朗和乌克兰的战争。 兼任德国副总理的Klingbeil在下周一于美国北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔开始的会议前表示：“所有这些都对全球经济发展构成毒害。”他说，减少“全球范围内的巨大不确定性”是每个人的责任，而G20正是明确这一点的合适平台。
text_en: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil plans to call for an end to economically damaging conflicts, including tariff disputes and wars in Iran and Ukraine, during talks with G20 counterparts in the United States. Klingbeil, who also serves as vice chancellor, said ahead of the meetings starting Monday in Asheville, North Carolina: "All of this is poison for global economic development." He said reducing "the enormous uncertainty worldwide" is everyone's responsibility, and the G20 is the right platform to make that clear.
